title: Metronome write-up and scrapbook
summary: He was named alongside Buddy Rich in Metronome around 1937-38 and kept a scrapbook of Sharkey's press.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Being honored: NEA Jazz Masters and other awards

blocks.x: Seeing Buddy Rich in town reminds me that I had a write-up in Metronome magazine, Buddy Rich and myself in the same column, saying youngsters who you must watch in the future. And they mentioned myself and Buddy Rich in the same column.
What year was that? Oh, about 38.
I think I have a copy of it at home. You could just get the date.
I'll make a copy of it. I'll look it up. I'll look it up and bring it to you.

I more or less had a scrapbook, you know, of Sharky's band when we were at Nix in New York. We had a write-up by every columnist except Walter Winchell, and I don't know why. And I think we later did get one from Winchell, but I'm not sure of that.
